description: This source file defines the CacheUtils class, providing utility methods for cache operations such as put, get, remove, and list keys, specifically tailored for use with Spring Cache and Ehcache within the sales manager project.

classes.name: CacheUtils
classes.description: A utility class for cache operations, including storing, retrieving, and removing cached items, as well as listing cache keys related to merchant stores.

methods.name: putInCache
methods.description: Puts an object into the cache with the specified key.

methods.name: getFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the cache by its key.

methods.name: getCacheKeys
methods.description: Returns a list of cache keys associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: shutDownCache
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to shut down or clear cache (currently empty).

methods.name: removeFromCache
methods.description: Removes a specific entry from the cache by key.

methods.name: removeAllFromCache
methods.description: Removes all cache entries associated with a specific MerchantStore.
